scope: Changes after Klee completes Witch's Homework; distinct from the team Secret Rite condition.

sources.description: HoYoWiki Hexerei entry: constellation 1 grants Klee 60% attack for 12 seconds after the additional spark triggers.

Klee constellation section distinguishes Hexerei upgrades from the separate team Secret Rite: constellation 1 grants 60% attack for 12 seconds; constellation 6 grants Klee 50% and other party members 10% Pyro damage bonus for 25 seconds.

limitations: The original spark is probabilistic. The attack buff is evaluated from an explicitly confirmed active window, not inferred from every attack.
The older adopted genshin-db snapshot predates these upgrades.
